chatbot.title: Assignment Assistant
chatbot.greet: Hello! 👋 Which course would you like to create an assignment for?
chatbot.topicPrompt: Great choice! 🎯 What topic would you like to work on? (e.g., mathematics, linked list). After entering the topic, I'll ask you to select **easy / medium / hard**.
chatbot.difficultyPrompt: **Difficulty level:** Easy produces a very limited assignment (single file / a few short functions); medium is a typical homework; hard requires multi-part work with stricter criteria. Select one below.
chatbot.easyDesc: Small scope — a few short functions, simple math/repetition code (e.g., factorial, small N).
chatbot.mediumDesc: Typical homework — several module functions or a small class structure, some data structures or numerical steps.
chatbot.hardDesc: Multi-part — edge cases, additional scenarios, comparative methods, or heavier algorithm expectations.
chatbot.fetchingSuggestions: Getting AI assignment suggestions for you... ✨
chatbot.noSuggestions: Sorry, I couldn't generate suggestions. Could you elaborate on your hint a bit more?
chatbot.newSuggestionsMsg: Preparing 5 new suggestions with the same hint and difficulty…
chatbot.assignmentDesc: Assignment description — feel free to edit as you like
chatbot.editSaved: Edit saved. You can approve when ready.
chatbot.likedMsg: Great! Now let's select the submission deadline. 📅
chatbot.dislikedMsg: OK, going back to the list. You can pick another suggestion or type a new topic below to refresh the list.
chatbot.confirmCreate: Done! 📋 Do you confirm creating the following assignment?
chatbot.noCancelMsg: Understood, assignment not created. You can start again whenever you want. 👋
chatbot.securityCheck: Assignment Security Agent is performing a final check before saving...
chatbot.hintPlaceholder: Enter a topic, keyword, or detailed assignment description...
chatbot.hintNarrowPlaceholder: Type to narrow down (e.g., 'matrix multiplication', 'AVL tree')...
chatbot.resetHintMsg: Hint reset. Please type a new topic from scratch.
